requirement: Starting from empty routing tables on both routers, configure connectivity so that clients in 10.0.1.0/24 can reach the web server network 10.0.2.0/24 and receive responses, and block client access to the management network 10.0.99.0/24 on r1.
raw_response:
r1 | vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "ip route 10.0.2.0/24 10.0.12.2"
r1 | ip link add name br0 type bridge
r1 | ip addr add 10.0.12.1/30 brd + dev br0
r1 | vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "interface eth2"
r1 | vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "bridge pvid 1"
r1 | iptables -I FORWARD -s 10.0.1.0/24 -d 10.0.99.0/24 -j DROP
r1 | iptables -D FORWARD -s 10.0.1.0/24 -d 10.0.2.0/24 -j DROP
r1 | iptables -I FORWARD -s 10.0.1.0/24 -d 10.0.2.0/24 -j ACCEPT
r2 | vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "ip route 10.0.1.0/24 10.0.12.1"
r2 | ip link add name br0 type bridge
r2 | ip addr add 10.0.12.2/30 brd + dev br0
r2 | vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "interface eth1"
r2 | vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "bridge pvid 1"
r2 | vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "interface eth3"
r2 | vtysh -c "configure terminal" -c "ip route 10.0.1.0/24 10.0.12.1"
